Contract Generator.contract:
Contract LoanProcessingSystemSystem::loanPayment(loanid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loan: Loan = Loan.allInstance()->any(l|l.LoanID = loanid and
		l.Status = LSOPEN)
	precondition:
		loan.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		loan.RemainAmountToPay = loan.RemainAmountToPay-loan.RepaymentAmount and
		result = true
}
